title.note: Glossary keep: brand title; players search Roblox games by their English title (guide: game titles stay English).

hud.cast.note: Tu-imperative of 'a arunca (undița)', the angling sense of cast.

hud.reel.note: What a Romanian angler says when a fish bites ('trage!'). The technical verb 'Mulinează' (from mulinetă, the reel) is 9 chars, over the 8 budget. Same verb as the Auto Reel pass (Trage automat).

hud.bait_left.note: Label form so 0, 1 and 20+ all read correctly ('1 momeli', '20 momeli' would be wrong).

catch.success.note: Rarity tags are masculine singular (Rar, Legendar, Mitic) and agree with neuter/masculine 'un pește'; the fish name follows a colon, so feminine names (Anghilă-felinar) need no agreement. Mid-sentence capital on the tag reads as a tier label, as in the guide's egg.hatched pattern. 'Un pește' also removes the English a/an problem.

catch.escaped.note: Generic 'peștele' as subject, valid for any species. Single ellipsis character per the Romanian guide instead of three dots.

catch.new_record.note: For the developer: {weight} arrives as '12.4'; Romanian writes '12,4' (decimal comma). Please format the number per locale.

fish.golden_carp.note: Golden-colored carp; base form, masculine singular, no article.

fish.lantern_eel.note: Anghilă = eel, felinar = lantern; hyphenated compound like Romanian fish names pește-spadă, rechin-ciocan. Keeps the glowing-lantern idea. Feminine noun, but it only appears alone or after a colon, so no agreement issue.

rarity.mythic.note: Masculine singular tier label, agreeing with 'pește' in catch.success; ranks above Legendar as myth above legend.

shop.rods.note: Plural of undiță, the fishing rod.

shop.equipped.note: State label; feminine participle agreeing with 'undiță' (rod). Button is the imperative Echipează.

shop.buy_robux.note: Price-label style from the guide: avoids 'cu 99 de Robux' agreement at 20+.

pass.auto_reel.note: Same verb as hud.reel ('Trage'), as the glossary asks. The noun form 'Tragere automată' is 16 (over 14) and 'tragere' also suggests shooting or a lottery draw. The Creator Hub pass name should match.

pass.lucky_bait.text: Momeala de noroc îți dublează șansa de a prinde pești rari!
pass.lucky_bait.note: Pass name 'Momeală de noroc' follows the guide's 'Poțiune de noroc' (Lucky Potion) pattern and uses the glossary words luck (noroc) and Bait (momeală). As the sentence subject it takes the definite article (Momeala). 'pești rari' uses the Rare tier word.

sell.done.note: Label form for both numbers: '{count} pești' and '{coins} monede' break at 1 and need 'de' at 20+ (e.g. '340 de monede'). Literally 'Fish sold: 12. Coins received: 340!'.

sell.prompt.note: Guide pattern 'Apasă E ca să ...'; 19/21. Source-side issue stands: phone and console players have no E key.

ascend.button.note: Noun as the mechanic name (10/10); Romanian has no everyday verb for 'ascend' that is neither religious ('Înălțare' is the Ascension feast) nor climbing ('Urcă'). 'Ascensiune' is the secular word for a rise. Same word in ascend.confirm.

ascend.confirm.text: Faci ascensiunea acum? O iei de la capăt, dar prinzi pești rari cu {bonus} % mai des.
ascend.confirm.note: 'Faci ascensiunea' uses the same Ascensiune word as the button. 'O iei de la capăt' = start over. Non-breaking space before % per the guide (CLDR ro).

weather.storm.text: Vine furtuna! Peștii rari mușcă momeala.
weather.storm.note: 'A mușca momeala' is the angling phrase for fish taking the bait; naming the bait keeps it from reading as fish biting people. 'Rari' matches the Rare tier word.

quest.catch_n.note: Count after a colon because '{n} pești' breaks at 1 ('1 pești') and at 20+ ('20 de pești'). Moonlit Bay translated as 'Golful Lunii' (Moon's Bay) per the developer's translate decision; in-world signs should match.

quest.claim.note: Guide: 'Revendică' is stiff for kids; 'Primește' (receive) is the claim-reward button.

friends.boost.note: 'Aduce noroc' (brings luck) is the natural collocation for luck. Non-breaking space before % per the guide.

trade.sent.note: 'lui {player}' works for any name and gender (guide); the participle agrees with 'cerere', not the player.

trade.accept.note: Perfect compus is gender-neutral. 'your trade' rendered as 'schimbul' (the trade); 'cererea ta de schimb' would be 32/33 and stiffer.

codes.enter.note: Guide reference wording for the code box placeholder.

codes.redeemed.note: 'Cod folosit!' could read as the error 'code already used', so 'activat'. 'your' dropped per the guide.

afk.kicked.text: Ai fost AFK prea mult timp, așa că nu mai pescuiești.
afk.kicked.note: 'Idle' as AFK: the natural Romanian adjective 'inactiv' is masculine and would exclude girls ('Ai fost inactiv'); AFK never inflects and is the word Roblox players use. Does not mention removal from the server, as the source doesn't.

event.ends.note: 'Se termină peste {time}' is 17, over the 14 budget; 'Timp rămas' (time left) is the usual countdown label. For the developer: {time} arrives as '2d 4h', but day in Romanian is 'zi', so 'd' reads wrong; Romanian short form is '2 z 4 h'.

daily.streak.text: Ziua {day} din serie! Revino mâine pentru alte recompense.
daily.streak.note: 'Ziua {day}' with a cardinal works for every day number (no ordinal agreement). 'for more' made explicit as 'alte recompense' (more rewards), as the context says.

tip.night.text: Sfat: unii pești mușcă momeala doar noaptea.
tip.night.note: Same angling phrase as weather.storm ('mușcă momeala').

group.join.text: Alătură-te grupului pentru 50 de momeli gratis!
group.join.note: 'Alătură-te' matches Roblox's Romanian listing ('Alătură-te unui Grup'). '50 de momeli' needs 'de' at 20+; 'gratis' never inflects.

leaderboard.biggest.note: 'Biggest' = heaviest per context, so 'cel mai greu pește' (heaviest fish); 18/18. 'Cea mai mare captură' is 20 and suggests size, not weight.
